## Microsoft Security Logging Guide: Cost Estimation and Volume Monitoring

Measures billable versus free GB per table and solution, detects daily ingestion spikes, identifies top noisy event IDs and hosts for DCR filtering, and calculates daily GB percentiles for commitment tier sizing. Built from `queries/cost/` and `docs/cost-estimation.md`.

content.query:
// 06. Commitment tier sizing: daily billable GB distribution over 30 complete days
// Run in: Defender portal > Advanced hunting (with Sentinel workspace selected) or Log Analytics Logs.
// Compare DailyAvgGB, P50, P90 and P95 against regional Sentinel pay-as-you-go vs 100 GB/day+ commitment tiers.
Usage
| where StartTime >= startofday(ago(31d)) and EndTime < startofday(now())
| where IsBillable == true
| summarize DailyBillableGB = sum(Quantity) / 1000.0 by Day = bin(StartTime, 1d)
| summarize
    DaysMeasured = count(),
    MinGB = round(min(DailyBillableGB), 2),
    AvgGB = round(avg(DailyBillableGB), 2),
    P50_GB = round(percentile(DailyBillableGB, 50), 2),
    P90_GB = round(percentile(DailyBillableGB, 90), 2),
    P95_GB = round(percentile(DailyBillableGB, 95), 2),
    MaxGB = round(max(DailyBillableGB), 2),
    Total30dGB = round(sum(DailyBillableGB), 2)
content.title: Commitment tier sizing (30-day daily billable GB percentiles)
Daily billable GB trend and anomaly flags (30 days)
Billable vs free GB per table (30 days)

content.query:
// 02. Billable GB by Sentinel solution and data type over the last 30 complete days
// Run in: Defender portal > Advanced hunting (with Sentinel workspace selected) or Log Analytics Logs.
Usage
| where StartTime >= startofday(ago(31d)) and EndTime < startofday(now())
| where IsBillable == true
| extend SolutionGroup = iff(Solution == "SecurityInsights", "MicrosoftSentinel", Solution)
| summarize
    BillableGB30d = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000.0, 2),
    DailyAvgGB = round(sum(Quantity) / 1000.0 / 30.0, 2)
    by SolutionGroup, DataType
| order by BillableGB30d desc
content.title: Billable GB by Sentinel solution and table (30 days)

content.query:
// 03. Estimated billable GB by Azure resource / connector source over the last 7 days
// Run in: Defender portal > Advanced hunting (with Sentinel workspace selected) or Log Analytics Logs.
// Uses the _BilledSize system column across high-volume tables to pinpoint which resource or DCR drives spend.
// ASSUMPTION: Not every workspace has all tables below; isfuzzy=true skips missing tables.
union withsource=Table isfuzzy=true
    SecurityEvent, WindowsEvent, Syslog, CommonSecurityLog, AzureDiagnostics,
    StorageBlobLogs, AKSAudit, AKSAuditAdmin, AZFWNetworkRule, AZFWApplicationRule,
    SigninLogs, AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs, MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where _IsBillable == true
| extend Source = coalesce(
    tostring(column_ifexists("_ResourceId", "")),
    tostring(column_ifexists("Computer", "")),
    tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceVendor", "")),
    "Tenant-scoped"
)
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    GB7d = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9, 3),
    EstDailyGB = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9 / 7.0, 3)
    by Table, Source
| order by GB7d desc
| take 50
content.title: Estimated billable GB by Azure resource and source (7 days)

content.query:
// 05. Top noisy Windows Event IDs, hosts, and AzureDiagnostics categories over 7 days
// Run in: Defender portal > Advanced hunting (with Sentinel workspace selected) or Log Analytics Logs.
// Run each section separately or unioned to decide what to filter in DCRs or move to the Data lake tier.

// 5a. Top noisy Windows SecurityEvent IDs by billed GB
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where _IsBillable == true
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    GB7d = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9, 3),
    UniqueHosts = dcount(Computer)
    by EventID, Activity
| order by GB7d desc
| take 20
content.title: Top noisy Windows SecurityEvent IDs (7 days)

content.query:
// 5b. Top noisy accounts in SecurityEvent (often service accounts or scanners)
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where _IsBillable == true
| where isnotempty(Account)
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    GB7d = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9, 3),
    EventIDs = make_set(EventID, 10)
    by Account
| order by GB7d desc
| take 20
content.title: Top noisy accounts in SecurityEvent (7 days)

content.query:
// 5c. Top noisy AzureDiagnostics resource types and categories
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where _IsBillable == true
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    GB7d = round(sum(_BilledSize) / 1e9, 3),
    Resources = dcount(_ResourceId)
    by ResourceType, Category
| order by GB7d desc
| take 20
content.title: Top noisy AzureDiagnostics categories and resources (7 days)
